translation.name: GOD ETER AGERKE NAMDERASEM TUMA YENBO

book.name: 1 TESALONAIKA
book.title: 1 TESALONAIKA Pol ere Tesalonaika komri tatame emne kiyi bas rasem siglou.

content: Pol ere Timoti erne Tesalonaika komke won yin ere emne kobo late yim.
Nema kemne yan late kelu soplawoyim, nema pap yaperwai meten etep wom. Nesetwou nesa Atens komke temente.

Timoti eterne nesa erne won kemne yin late. Nema etep wom. Timoti ere neremri Kristen mase. Ere God eteri yaku kerebe tame, Krais eri tuma yenbo wusoube tame. Nesa erne won yim, ere keremne kobo late yim. Kem Apei God erne kenawaike som abobetete, kem mure petbetete, ere kemne eke kobo late yim.
Be wos yaper kemne tete, kem mane amete, kem God erne mane mesginte, ere kemne eke kir kobo late yim. God ere kemne etep wom. Kem mus mette nenbe. Etep wom. Kerem kem etep metten.

Kiyi nema keremken temenem, nema kemne etep wom. Yuri tatame eme nemne wule yaper nente nenbe. Nema Kristen tatame, nema mus mette nenbe. Etep wom. Ete tuma ere sekenwaike tem. Nema mus metbetem. Kem etep lam.

Kem mus metbetem, an kemne beke la, an pap yaper metem. Eke an Timoti erne won kemne yan lam. Ere kemri kenawaike abobe wule late yam. Kap Satan ere kemne teitkwunem. Kap neremri kerem yaku ere bepou oksubu yim o? An etep abom, eke an Timoti erne won yim.
Timoti ere sene yan tuma yenbo wusowum, Pol ere metekwasem.

Timoti ere kemne yin lan sene yam, ere nemne tuma yenbo etep wusowum. Tesalonaikari Kristen tatame eme God erne kenawaike som abobe, eme akeite tatame emne kobo lan noub nenbe. Eme kemne kwokwos kwokwos kemne kenake late abobe. Ere nemne etep wusowum. Nema kemne late nenbekap, ere etep wom.
Geisimase, kem kenawaike abobe wule noub sebe, nema etep metem, nema mure peten pap yenbo metem. Be wos be wos yaper nemne tebe, nema mus metbe, nema kemne abon pap yenbo metbe.
Ye. Kem Aneyen eri tuma, eri wule som noub setek, nema metekwasen yenbosubuwai temente.
Etep tebe, nema kemne noub abon God erne pir wobe. Nema eterken namdebe, nema keremne pap yenbo ten metekwasbe, eke nema erne pir wobe.
Neirken yabelken nema erne som wometbe, ere nemne kelu peteran nema kemne yan late. Kap kem erne som beke abo, eke God eteri tuma nema kemne wusoutek, kem kenawaike ek abote.
Pol ere God erne etep wometem. An emne yin late.
Nema abobe, neremri Apei God eter, neremri Aneyen Jisasken epe neremri kelu eyartek, nema kemne ek yan late.
Kem awoawo kobo labekap, kem tatame emne kobo labekap, ete wule ere kenake tete. Nema kemne kobo kenake lan noub nenbekap, kemri kobo labekap, etepkap kenake tete. Nema Aneyen erne etep wometbe.

Nema erne wometbe, ere keremri selpap yenbowai nente. Keremri selpap yenbo nente, yuri Aneyen Jisas ere eri tatame etemken yate yabel, kemri selpap noub temente. Ete yabelke nemri Apei ere kemne late, ere kemne tatame yenbowai late. Ere kemne ker beke ras.
